cover-director.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a Kazakh woman film director in her thirties on a small commercial photo set, holding a director's viewfinder up to one eye and framing a single tall glass of iced latte standing on a pale marble counter a few metres away. One large softbox light on a stand illuminates the glass; cables, a wooden apple box and a camera on a tripod sit softly out of focus. She wears a muted deep violet linen shirt with rolled sleeves; real skin texture, faint freckles, focused calm expression, natural relaxed hands. Environment: a quiet studio with warm paper-colored walls. Lighting: soft key from the softbox with gentle peach warmth, cool lavender shadows. Composition 4:5 vertical, the director and the glass in the upper two thirds; the lower third is a calm, dark, out-of-focus studio floor in deep shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-formula.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph from a slightly high angle of seven sheets of translucent tracing paper stacked with small offsets on a dark walnut drafting table, each sheet carrying one layer of a hand-drawn storyboard frame in soft graphite: an outline of a glass, small motion lines, a sketched counter, light rays, film grain hatching, a lens circle, tiny detail marks, all illegible abstract strokes with no letters or numbers. A pair of hands lifts the top sheet at one corner. Brass drafting compass, a lavender pencil and a steel ruler without numbers lie nearby. Real skin texture on the hands, cuff of a peach linen shirt. Lighting: cool morning window light from the left mixing with a warm peach desk-lamp reflection, crisp gentle shadows. Composition 4:5 vertical, the stacked layers in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, dark, uniform wood of the table. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-platform.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a grand old covered shopping arcade at dusk, a long glass-roofed passage lined on both sides with many small wooden shopfronts, each window glowing softly in its own tone: warm peach, pale lavender, amber, cool violet, every shop window empty of signs and products, just luminous glass. A single person in a long paper-beige coat walks away down the middle of the passage, seen from behind, deciding which door to enter. Mosaic floor, wrought-iron details, deep indigo sky through the glass roof. Lighting: mixed warm shop glow and cool dusk ambient, gentle halation around the windows. Composition 4:5 vertical, the glowing passage in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, dark, uniform stone floor in shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-video.webp: Fine-art editorial behind-the-scenes photograph of a cinematographer in his thirties slowly pushing a small camera dolly along short steel tracks toward a single white cup of coffee on a wooden café table, his hand steady on the dolly handle, eye on a small monitor whose screen is turned away. He wears a deep violet knit sweater; real skin texture, concentrated calm expression. Environment: an empty small café before opening, chairs on the tables, warm paper-colored walls softly blurred. Lighting: low warm peach morning sun through the café window from the side, long soft shadows, delicate dust motes in the beam. Composition 4:5 vertical, the dolly, the man and the cup in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, dark floor with the tracks fading into shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-series.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a photographer's studio wall where a neat grid of twelve printed photographs is pinned with small brass pins; every print shows the same lavender ceramic cup in a different scene: on a marble counter, in a hand, on a windowsill, beside croissants, in snow, on a linen tablecloth, always the identical cup shape and color. A woman's hand pins one more print into the last empty spot of the grid. Real skin texture, a cuff of a paper-beige linen shirt. Lighting: soft diffuse daylight from the left with a warm peach accent, gentle shadows of the pins. Composition 4:5 vertical, the photo grid in the upper two thirds; the lower third is a calm, dark, uniform area of the wall and a shadowed worktable edge. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-sound.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a man in his late twenties recording a voice-over in a small cozy sound booth, speaking calmly into a large studio microphone with a round pop filter, closed-back headphones on, one hand lightly raised as if keeping rhythm, a printed script page in his other hand with illegible soft lines. Acoustic foam panels in muted lavender and deep violet tones behind him. He wears a paper-beige knit sweater; real skin texture, relaxed expressive face. Lighting: a single warm peach practical lamp from the side and cool lavender ambient fill, soft falloff into shadow. Composition 4:5 vertical, the man and microphone in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, dark, uniform desk surface in deep shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-practice.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a young Kazakh woman at a light wooden kitchen table by a tall window, photographing a small amber glass bottle of hair oil with her smartphone held in both hands; the phone screen faces away from the camera. The bottle stands on a simple rough stone block in soft daylight, a notebook with illegible scribbles and a cup of tea beside it. She wears a soft lavender blouse; real skin texture, focused half-smile, natural hands. Lighting: soft natural window daylight from the left, gentle warm peach bounce, delicate shadows. Composition 4:5 vertical, the woman, phone and bottle in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, softly shadowed tabletop. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-library.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of an old film archive room: tall metal shelves holding hundreds of round vintage film cans stacked in neat columns, their blank paper labels with no writing. Several cans in the middle are open, and from inside them glows a soft lavender light spilling onto the worn metal and the coiled film. A woman in a deep violet coat lifts one glowing can and looks into it, her face softly lit from below. Real skin texture, calm curiosity. Lighting: ambient darkness with a distant warm peach tungsten work lamp and the cool lavender glow from the cans, rich deep indigo shadows, slight halation. Composition 4:5 vertical, the glowing cans in the upper two thirds; the lower third is a calm, dark, uniform area of lower shelves in deep shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
cover-finish.webp: Fine-art editorial photograph of a small vintage screening room, seen from behind the last row: a single person sits relaxed in the front row of red-violet velvet seats, watching a bright projected image on the screen that shows only a soft abstract warm sunrise glow with no recognizable content. The projector beam cuts through the dark room with fine dust, lavender and peach light spilling over the seat backs. A feeling of quiet pride at the end of a long project. Lighting: the projector beam as the only key light, deep violet darkness everywhere else, gentle halation. Composition 4:5 vertical, the screen, beam and figure in the upper two thirds; the lower third is the calm, dark, uniform rows of seats in shadow. Shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, fine visible grain, honest photographic realism, no CGI, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos.
gen-weak.webp: beautiful iced latte in a coffee shop, cinematic, perfect lighting, high quality advertising photo
gen-strong.webp:
An iced latte in a tall clear glass, 350 ml. Milk slowly marbles into the espresso, condensation droplets run down the glass. Pale marble counter of a small coffee shop at 8 am, a paper bag of croissants softly blurred in the background. Low morning sun from the right as if from an unseen window, long soft shadow on the counter. Live-action photograph, 4:5, shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400, visible grain. Medium close-up, 85mm, f/2.8, glass in the left third. Real ice cubes, visible condensation texture.
NEGATIVE: steam, vapour, CGI gloss, plastic look, extra cups, text.
gen-sign.webp:
Live-action photograph, 4:5, 35mm film grain. A small bakery storefront at dusk in winter. Above the door hangs a wooden sign; the only text is "NAN" in hand-painted cream serif capital letters, centred on the sign, nothing else is written anywhere. Warm light spills from the shop window onto the snowy pavement. Eye level, 35mm, f/2.8.
NEGATIVE: extra words, misspelled letters, random signs, watermark, CGI.
gen-sheet.webp:
Character reference sheet, three panels side by side on a flat medium-grey background (#808080, never white), thin dividers. Panel 1: full body front view, feet visible. Panel 2: full body back view. Panel 3: head-and-shoulders close-up. The face is visible only in panel 3; erase the face from the full-body panels. Character: a 30-year-old barista, 175 cm, short dark hair, small scar through the LEFT eyebrow, olive linen apron over a white T-shirt, black jeans. Neutral soft even wrap-around light, near-shadowless, 5600K, eye catchlights. One identical person in all panels.
NEGATIVE: text, gradient, vignette, cast shadows, second person.
gen-banner.webp:
Editorial still life photograph, 16:9, live-action. A bouquet of white peonies wrapped in kraft paper lies on a pale linen tablecloth in the right third of the frame. The left 60% is plain empty background reserved for headline text. One hard late-morning sun key from the right, crisp leaf shadows across the cloth, 5600K. 70mm, f/4, slightly high angle. Palette: cream, soft green, one accent of dusty pink. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no letters, no logos anywhere.
NEGATIVE: objects in the empty area, CGI, oversaturated colours, watermark.
gen-food.webp:
Overhead food photograph, 4:5, natural film look with soft grain. A plate of beshbarmak with thin hand-cut noodles, tender lamb and onion sauce on a dark walnut table, a bowl of broth and a small dish of baursaks beside it, a hand reaching in from the lower right with a fork. Top-down 90-degree angle, 50mm, everything sharp. One soft daylight key from the top left, 5200K, real contact shadows under the plates. Glistening sauce, flour dust on the noodles.
NEGATIVE: plastic food, CGI, oversaturated colours, steam, extra fingers, text, logos.
